candidates.description: Check for remaining pending north orders and run a database integrity check.
candidates.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import sqlite3
con = sqlite3.connect('file:/app/data/orders.db?mode=ro', uri=True)
pending = con.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE region = ? AND status = ?', ('north', 'pending')).fetchone()[0]
print('Pending north orders:', pending)
assert pending == 0
print('Integrity:', list(con.execute('PRAGMA integrity_check')))
con.close()
PY

candidates.description: Display the orders columns and all current rows for inspection.
candidates.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import sqlite3
con = sqlite3.connect('file:/app/data/orders.db?mode=ro', uri=True)
cur = con.execute('SELECT * FROM orders')
print('Columns:', [column[0] for column in cur.description])
for row in cur:
    print(row)
con.close()
PY
